calibrated_validation.description: The one substantive reply (turn 4) held the user's core worry with a specific, honest gut check that even validated the fairness of their grievance ('even when the underlying point is fair'). But after the user quotably named the Dave-fairness worry ('does it still sound like I'm gunning for Dave?') and then a Sunday send decision, every later reply was the identical process stub — acknowledging the exact ask while never answering it, three times, leaving the decisional moment with no uptake. That is a repeated present-plus-flatten skip of a lighter concern rather than person-absence, with no V2 or V3 anywhere.
calibrated_validation.quote: I'll check prior context on Dave and Mom's care so the send/don't-send call isn't generic, then I'll give you a clear yes or no on Draft 3.
